title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 54 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 54)

content.overview: Section 54 provides for reference to arbitration where a judicial authority is seized of a matter covered by a Geneva Convention arbitration agreement, subject to the statutory prima facie validity exception.

distinctions.title: Judicial reference and prima facie validity

rows.left: A judicial authority must refer the covered matter to arbitration when seized of it, subject to the statutory prima facie validity exception concerning the arbitration agreement.
rows.right: Distinguish a section 54 reference from a full merits determination or an unrestricted trial of the arbitration agreement.
